_meta: G6 fragment (owner: AIRDEF6). CONTRACTS_G6: rules.g6_airdef (section 12). New ids/keys only; numbers are PROVISIONAL balance fixtures. Per-def numbers (radar radius, awacs radius/aa_acc_mult, ciws radius/shots_per_min, jammer radius, net_capture salvage, anti_drone_mult) live on the defs (CONTENT6).

g6_airdef._doc: scan_every: ticks between radar picture / RadarContact / AWACS reveal passes. awacs_mark_ticks: how long an AWACS reveal (e.marked_until) lasts; > scan_every so a tracked aircraft stays revealed. contact_forget_scans: scans an aircraft must stay out of the picture before a new RadarContact can fire for it.

counter_drone._doc: drone_* select which air units count as drones (CIWS kills, nets capture, jammers drop, anti_drone_mult applies). intercept_classes: indirect weapon classes a CIWS may shoot down (rocket = a salvo weapon). net_default_cooldown_s: capture interval when the post has no weapon. jam_drops_guided: guided shots aimed into an enemy jam field drop (shot_blocked).
